en: Color postcard showing a mountain inn complex with steep shingle roofs set against dense forested hills. A rocky riverbank is in the foreground, and two 1970s–1980s coaches and a couple of cars are parked on the road; one bus has the word ROMANIA on its side. A sign on the left building reads AGAPIA. The reverse has Romanian text and a printed caption identifying the place.
